name: Ananda Madhumaya
tradition: Ananda Marga (Hindu/Tantric-yogic), founded by Shrii Shrii Anandamurti
technique: Rajadhiraja Yoga meditation, asanas, kirtan, fasting/detox practices
teacherAccess: Direct -- resident Dada/Didi monastic teachers live on-site
retreatOptions: 10-day Yoga & Detox program; multi-week teacher trainings; shorter seasonal retreats
about: A renovated former ceramics workshop and adjoining rural land near the pre-Columbian Xochicalco pyramids, purchased by the Ananda Marga mission since 2014. Hosts yoga/meditation retreats, teacher trainings, and 'spiritual lifestyle' volunteer programs for groups of 10-40, functioning partly as a monastic residence and partly as a bookable retreat venue an hour from Tepoztlan.
cost: Priced per-program; inquire directly for current rates
workNotes: Volunteers and some program participants do garden/kitchen work (karma yoga).
